name: Atrophy
overview: The passage in Matthew 12:10-13 reveals Jesus' authority to heal physical atrophy, specifically a withered hand, demonstrating His power to restore what was broken. Jesus challenges the legalistic mindset that restricts doing good on the Sabbath, illustrating that showing mercy and healing is lawful and honors God's intent. By commanding the man to stretch forth his hand, which is then fully restored, Christ not only heals the physical ailment but also affirms the value of human need over rigid tradition.
